name: Multi-Post
description: Standalone desktop app to pre-fill Facebook group posts (caption + photos). Never auto-posts.

scripts.dist: npm run build:renderer && npm run bundle-chromium && electron-builder -mw
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:renderer && npm run bundle-chromium && electron-builder -m
scripts.dist:mac-arm64: npm run build:renderer && npm run bundle-chromium && electron-builder -m --arm64
scripts.dist:mac-x64: npm run build:renderer && npm run bundle-chromium && electron-builder -m --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:renderer && npm run bundle-chromium && electron-builder -w
